UI_LXSI_desc: Brings every local character (split-screen included) up to a skill floor, once per character. Levels are only ever raised, never lowered.
UI_LXSI_enable_tip: Off = the mod does nothing. Characters who already got their skills keep them.
UI_LXSI_combat_tip: Strength, Fitness, Aiming and Reloading are raised to this level. 0 = leave them alone.
UI_LXSI_craft_tip: Carpentry, Metalworking, Electrical, Mechanics, Masonry, Blacksmith, Carving, Tailoring, Pottery, Glassmaking and Butchering are raised to this level. 5 unlocks most building recipes. 0 = leave them alone.
